description: Organized three days Hindi workshop on “बुनियादी सांख्यिकीय तकनीक और आनुवंशिकी में इसका अनुप्रयोग (Basic Statistical Techniques and its applications in Genetics)” from 03-05 August, 2022 at ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.
Organized 21 days CAFT training on “Prominent Statistical Tools for Data Science in Agriculture using R and Python” for faculty and scientist from 09-29 November, 2022 at ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.
Organized one day training cum exposure visit of SC students of Delhi on 8 Dec, 2023 at ICAR-IASRI.

Coordinated a one-day exposure visit during the Pusa Krishi Vigyan Mela on February 24, 2025, under the SCSP scheme of ICAR-IASRI for 110 farmers from the Scheduled Caste category. The farmers were from four villages in Dharuhera Block, Rewari District, Haryana and two villages in Khurja Block, Bulandshahr District, Uttar Pradesh.

Organized seven days training on Advanced Statistical Techniques in Ecological and Environmental Data Analysis in Agriculture (कृषि में पारिस्थितिकी एवं पर्यावरणीय डेटा विश्लेषण में उन्नत सांख्यिकी तकनीकें) held from June 24 to June 30, 2025.
Conducted a training program on Advanced Data Analytics and Predictive Modelling for Agricultural Research, held from 06th January 2026 to 17th January 2026.

Organized a One-week Workshop on ‘Artificial Intelligence and Statistical Approaches for Assessing Agricultural Performance’ in collaboration with the Agro-Economic Research Centre (AERC), Visva-Bharati held at Visva-Bharati University from 9th to 13th February 2026.
